questions.question: He struck me on the head. Here 'the' is used as -----.[]
questions.explanation: The" is used here to replace a possessive adjective (his/my). It refers to a specific part of the person mentioned.

questions.question: <u>The</u> more, <u>the</u> merrier. Underlined 'the's are -----.[]
questions.explanation: Used with comparative adjectives (the more... the merrier) to show that one thing depends on another. It functions like an adverb here

questions.question:
The soup is horrible; I am going to complain to ----- restaurant's owner.
The charge for ----- excess luggage is TK.600 per Kilo.[]
questions.explanation: We use "the" because "restaurant's owner" and "excess luggage" refer to specific things known to the speaker in that context.

questions.question: Where is ----- boy ? He is in ----- garden.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" for both because the speaker is asking about a specific boy and referring to a specific garden (likely the one attached to the house).

questions.question: The house has a beautiful garden. Let us sit in ----- garden.[]
questions.explanation: Once a noun (garden) is introduced with "a," any subsequent mention of that same noun uses "the" because it is now a specific, previously mentioned item.

questions.question: There is always discrimination between ----- rich and ----- poor.[]
questions.explanation: When adjectives like "rich" and "poor" are used to represent a whole group of people, they must be preceded by "the."

questions.question: ----- virtuous are always happy.[]
questions.explanation: "the" is used before the adjective "virtuous" to denote the entire class of virtuous people.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.[]
options: The Airport is a busy place.
questions.explanation: The" is used for a specific institution/place (Airport), and "a" is used before "busy place" because it is a singular countable noun being described generally.

questions.question: Indicate the correct sentence.[]
options: An ant is the intelligent insect.
The ant is an intelligent insect.
A ant is the intelligent insect.
An ant is a intelligent insect.
questions.explanation: "The" + singular noun (ant) can represent a whole species. "An" is used before "intelligent" because it starts with a vowel sound.

questions.question: নিচের কোন বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ ?[]
options: A Lion is a ferocious animal.
The Lion is a ferocious animal.
questions.explanation: "The" is used here to represent the entire class/species of lions. "A" is used before "ferocious animal" to classify it.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.[]
options: The cow is an useful animal.
A cow is an useful animal.
The cow is a useful animal.
questions.explanation: "The" represents the whole species. Use "a" before "useful" because it begins with a consonant sound (yoo-ful), not a vowel sound.

questions.question: ----- ant is ----- industrious creature.[]
questions.explanation: "The" represents the species. Use "an" before "industrious" because it starts with a vowel sound.

questions.question: ----- cat has ----- tail.[]
questions.explanation: "The" represents the species; "a" is used for a singular countable noun (tail).

questions.question: Choose the best answer.[]
questions.explanation: When "Man" or "Woman" is used in a general sense to mean humanity, no article is used.

questions.question: The Amazon in Brazil is ----- longest river in ----- South America. []
questions.explanation: Use "the" before superlative adjectives (longest). No article is used before the names of continents (South America).

questions.question:
Dhaka is ----- largest city in Bangladesh.
Which is ----- largest river in our country ?[]
questions.explanation: Always use "the" before superlative adjectives like "largest."

questions.question: Rakib is ----- finest young player now.[]
questions.explanation: "The" is required before the superlative adjective "finest."

questions.question: Honesty is ----- best policy.[]
questions.explanation: "The" is used before the superlative adjective "best."

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is incorrect ?[]
questions.explanation: Names of unique celestial objects (sky, earth, moon) must take "the." Using "A" is grammatically incorrect.

questions.question: Education is a must for all human beings to know their position in ----- universe.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" for unique entities like the universe.

questions.question: Do you see ----- blue sky ?[]
questions.explanation: Unique things like the sky always take the definite article.

questions.question:
----- earth moves around the sun.
----- earth is round.
He is tired of ----- world.[]
questions.explanation: Use "The" for unique objects like the earth and the world.

questions.question: He pulled ----- boy by ----- ear.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" before names of body parts when they are the object of a preposition (by the ear).

questions.question:
I struck him on ----- cheek.
He caught me by ----- neck.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" for specific body parts in this sentence structure.

questions.question: Kamal broke ----- in the accident.[]
questions.explanation: When referring to someone's own body part in an accident, the possessive pronoun (his) is more natural than "the."

questions.question: I pulled the cat by ----- tail.[]
questions.explanation: use "the" for a specific part of the animal being handled.

questions.question: I caught him by ----- hand.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" before the body part when using the "verb + person + by + the + body part" construction.

questions.question: He joined ----- army.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" before names of military branches or professions (the army, the navy).

questions.question: Sports medicine experts agree that ice should be applied immediately when an athlete suffers an injury to ----- leg.[]
questions.explanation: The context refers to a specific athlete's own leg, so the possessive pronoun (his) is used.

questions.question: Last summer we visited -----.[]

questions.explanation: Use "the" before country names that are a collection of states or contain words like "United" or "Republic."

questions.question:
He will leave for ----- USA.
He visited ----- USA last year.
I am going to ----- USA.
My uncle lives in ----- USA.[]
questions.explanation: the" is used for the United States of America.

questions.question:
----- Punjab is a province of Pakistan.
We visited ----- Deccan of India last year.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" before certain geographical regions or provinces that imply a collection or specific historical area (e.g., the Punjab, the Deccan).

questions.question:
----- English are industrious.
English is a language whereas ----- English is a nation.
He speaks English like ----- English.[]
questions.explanation: When a language name refers to the people/nation, use "the" (e.g., The English are industrious). When it refers to the speech, use no article.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.[]
options: He speaks the English like English.
He speak the English like English.
He speaks English like the English.
questions.explanation: He speaks English (language) like the English (people)."

questions.question: The English' means -----[]
questions.explanation: The English" refers to the people of England collectively.

questions.question: The French' refers to -----.[]
questions.explanation: "The French" refers to the people of France.

questions.question:
French is ----- language of ----- people of France.
Bengali is ----- language of ----- people of Bangladesh.
English is ----- language of ----- people of England.
[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" for a specific language of a specific people (the language of the people).

questions.question: ----- English speak English.[]
questions.explanation: "The English (people) speak English (language)."

questions.question:
----- Bangladeshis are proud of their glorious past.
----- Bangladeshis are a brave nation.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" before plural nationalities/ethnic groups to describe them as a collective whole (The Bangladeshis).

questions.question:
This is ----- better of two.
[]
questions.explanation: In the structure "the + comparative + of the two," use "the" before the adjective.

questions.question: Of ----- two girls she is the better. []
questions.explanation: "the" is used before a comparative when followed by "of the two."

questions.question: ----- earlier, the better.[]
questions.explanation: Parallel structures (The... the...) require "the" before comparatives: "The earlier, the better

questions.question: He is ----- man of the match/series.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" for unique titles or awards within a specific context (the man of the match).

questions.question: ----- Mount Everest is the highest peak in the Himalayas.[]
questions.explanation: Do not use "the" before names of single mountain peaks (e.g., Mount Everest). Note: Use "the" for mountain ranges (the Himalayas).

questions.question: ----- sandwip is a big island.[]
questions.explanation: Do not use "the" before names of single islands (Sandwip). Note: Use "the" for island groups (the Andamans).

questions.question: ----- Nelson is a British warship.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" before the names of ships or warships (the Nelson)

questions.question: I read ----- Quran.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" before the names of holy books (the Quran).

questions.question: ----- Andamans are in ----- Indian ocean.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" before groups of islands (the Andamans) and names of oceans (the Indian Ocean)

questions.question: I read ----- Prothom Alo, which is ----- very popular newspaper in our country.[]
questions.explanation: Use "the" for names of newspapers (the Prothom Alo). Use "a" for a general description (a very popular newspaper).
